headline: Sugarslime or Sugartini
title: Sugarslime or Sugartini | Which Ice Evolution | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Sugarfish can become two stage three Ice Aniimo. Sugarslime has one hundred fifteen regen and five hundred twenty one total stats. Sugartini has one hundred fifteen attack and five hundred fifteen total stats, plus Cream Heal. Both cost a Freeze Stone at level sixty two, and Sugartini also asks you to defeat Alpha Sugartini. Choose Sugarslime for energy and Sugartini for healing. Which one are you picking? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Sugarfish evolution choice: Sugarslime has 115 regen and 521 total stats, Sugartini has 115 attack and 515 total stats plus Cream Heal. Both cost a Freeze Stone at level 62, and Sugartini also needs Alpha Sugartini defeated. Checked on aniimo.gg and GameWith in November 2026.
joke: Choosing between pudding and slime is the hardest decision in the Isles.
